Sound: clean airy mix, controlled reverb, soft delay, wide stereo. Vocal: female, distinct raspy, airy-textured, mature tone. Texture: pronounced rasp, audible vocal fry, slight grit. Style: spoken word, rap cadence. NOT singing. Rules: no melody, no sustain. Each word separate. Hard stop each phrase. Timing: lock to beat grid, words align with kick/snare hits. Phrasing: choppy, staccato, clipped, groove-synced. Delivery: percussive, consonant-driven. Pitch: near-monotone. Flow: relaxed, slightly behind snare but locked. Ending: last syllable extended, raspy breathy fade with fry. Core: drum-locked spoken vocal over bass, pads, water pluck.
